name: DependentMapping
summary: A class whose persistence is handled entirely by another class, because it never exists alone.

roles.name: DependentMapping
roles.summary: A class with no mapper of its own: its owner loads and saves it. It suits what has no independent life — a line on an order, a note on a record — and the rule that keeps it honest is that nothing outside the owner may hold a reference to one, because nothing else can guarantee its state.
